title: Routed campus ticket: unreachable next hop
summary: Repair an invalid static-route next hop without disturbing the return path.
brief: SITE-A cannot reach SITE-B in a fictional three-router campus. All required destination and return prefixes are configured, but EDGE-A points its remote route at an address that is not a reachable router neighbor. Use the router consoles, LLDP, route tables, and host ping to identify and correct the next hop. This topology evaluates directly connected and static IPv4 forwarding only; it does not model OSPF adjacency or route exchange.
objectives: Identify the unreachable static next hop
Repair EDGE-A's route to the SITE-B subnet
Verify end-to-end IPv4 reachability without changing the return route
hints: Read the selected route, then verify whether its next hop exists on the adjacent routed link.
LLDP identifies EDGE-A's actual neighbor; compare its interface addressing.
Remove the incorrect route before adding the same prefix with the correct next hop.
